title: Metadata
description: Immutable Business Transaction metadata supplied by the calling application. Not evaluated by Policy. businessTransactionId is the only required field; it must match the top-level businessTransactionId. Parmana rejects a mismatch with a 400.

businessTransactionId.description: Unique Business Transaction identifier. Must be a valid UUID.

correlationId.description: Optional correlation identifier used by the calling application.

tenantId.description: Optional tenant identifier for multi-tenant deployments.

submittedBy.description: Identity of the calling application or principal.

submittedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the Business Transaction was submitted.
